name: @geocoding/ui-shared
description: Code shared between ui/mobile and ui/desktop, consumed via relative source imports (no build step) -- see ui/mobile's metro.config.js and ui/desktop's vite.config.ts for how each bundler is told to watch/resolve this folder. Deliberately has no dependency on maplibre-gl or any other package with class-based types: a separate copy here would be a structurally-identical but nominally-distinct type from each app's own copy, which TypeScript treats as incompatible (confirmed the hard way -- see git history). Map integration code stays duplicated per-app for that reason.
